title: universal lid with silicone edge
text: universal lid with silicone edge. I was so happy with the small one, I came back for the large one.  I need to replace a lid for a small 8" fry pan. It fit perfectly.  I am so happy with how it fits and cleans up.  It is dishwasher safe - I put it on the top rack when I received it.  However, I mostly hand wash with the pan as it is so easy to clean.  The silicone edge of the lid sort of seats it onto the pan.  It's just a nice, effective fit.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new new info seem useful.  And since I purchased the larger one I definitely will update if there is anything different to report.

product_metadata.title: Ecolution Universal Lid for Pots, Pans and Skillets Vented Tempered Glass, Fits 9.5 inch to 12 inch Cookware, Dishwasher Safe, Replacement Lid
features: UNIVERSAL AND SPACE SAVING – Designed to fit multiple 9.5 inch, 10 inch, 11 inch and 12 inch cookware. Works with fry pans, pots, saucepans, skillets, stock pots, woks, cast iron pans and practically any other style of cookware. Eliminate kitchen cabinet clutter by replacing your worn-out lids with this multipurpose, compact lid.

EASY TO USE - Transparent, tempered glass allows you to monitor your food as you cook without having to remove the lid. Vented to release excess moisture and pressure preventing accidental spillovers while still locking in all the moisture and flavors in your food.

HIGH QUALITY, DURABLE DESIGN – Designed with high quality, tempered glass which is both safer and more durable than standard glass. Durable, high heat resistant silicone edge clings to your cookware also preventing accidental spillovers.
EASY TO CLEAN – Dishwasher safe. Save time and make your clean up a breeze by placing the Universal Lid right in the dishwasher after use.
SAVES YOU MONEY - Our high-quality universal lid allows you to replace worn-out or missing lids without having to buy new cookware.
description: Prevent spillovers, keep an eye on your cooking with the Ecolution universal glass lid. If you need a dependable, versatile lid to fit multiple pot and pan sizes, choose the Ecolution universal glass lid for 9.5 inch to 12 inch cookware. Not only does it work beautifully, it's dishwasher safe and exceptionally easy to use and clean. It may even be more useful than a traditional pot lid because it can fit cookware of nonstandard sizes and will save storage space in your cabinet. Sturdily constructed of temperature safe glass and stay put silicone, this 9.5 to 12 inch lid has a steam vent to release the pressure, helping to prevent messy boil overs. Best of all, our durable-high-quality universal lid adds the cooking convenience you require without having to replace your existing cookware. Use it with frying pans, saucepans and skillets.
